name: ElevenLabs
description: Provides an Elevenlabs provider for the AI module.
project_description: ElevenLabs registers as a provider plugin for the AI module, exposing the ElevenLabs voice API through the AI suite's operation-type abstraction. It supplies three operation types: text-to-speech (with predefined professional voices or your own cloned voices), speech-to-speech (re-voice an existing audio file), and audio-to-audio (noise/voice isolation). Because it plugs into the AI module, any code or module that requests those operations through the AI abstraction, including the AI Automator, can be served by ElevenLabs without vendor-specific code. The API key is stored as a reference to a Key entity (via the key module), never inline in configuration. It requires an ElevenLabs account and API key with access to Text to Speech, Speech to Speech, Audio Isolation, Users, Voices, Models and History. Sponsored by FreelyGive; refactor work by Kanopi Studios.
